title: IR Forward 11:15: "Five Documents, Five Numbers?"

fields.to: Priya Natarajan; Marcus Delaney; Gerald Okafor; Tessa Brandt
fields.subject: Please check before 11:30 – five documents, five numbers?
fields.note:
I'm pulling this together for my analyst calls. Two analysts and one institutional holder are still waiting for me. Here's what I'm seeing:

• Correction draft v2 (newsroom/accounts): 'approximately 412,000 accounts', 'payment tokens, not card numbers'. Approver field is blank.
• Customer care chat macro CC-INC-02 (live since 10:20): 'up to 1.9 million customers may be affected; no card data was accessed.' Full text is in the forward from Customer Care below.
• Customer email draft v3 (INC-0309-CUST-NOTICE-DRAFT-v3): '412,000', but it says 'your card information was not affected.'
• My analyst talking points (from the 10:40 cell notes): 'roughly 400,000; under investigation.'
• 8-K draft from outside counsel, Item 8.01 shell: 'certain customer information for up to 1.9 million registered accounts.'
• Company accounts: the 08:20 post ('No payment information was involved') is still pinned.

The statement log has no CCO approval time for the macro or for my talking points.

Which version is true, and who signed it? I can't get on a call with an analyst at 11:30 using a number that our own customer email or a filing contradicts this afternoon.
fields.signature:
Shauna Pike
Director, Investor Relations
Tallis Home Products, Inc.
x4220

original.subject: Live care macro text, as you asked
original.body:
Here is exactly what my agents and chat are sending right now. Chat macro CC-INC-02, live since 10:20 ET:

"Thank you for contacting Tallis. We are investigating a security issue involving our web store. Up to 1.9 million customers may be affected; no card data was accessed. We have no confirmation that your account is involved. As a precaution, please reset your Tallis password and do not click links in emails offering refunds."

We built it from the 08:20 statement and the 1.9 million figure in the press coverage, because the floor needed something by 09:27. Legal looked at a version by phone. I don't have a CCO approval time for it.

Queue at 11:05: 305 waiting, 41-minute average wait. Under our plan I've moved 40 agents from the order desk. The web banner is ready to switch on, but I have no approved banner text.

If the number or the card line changes, tell me which wording to load. A macro swap takes about 10 minutes to reach all 120 agents.

Mateo Ruiz
Head of Customer Care
x4400

instructorNote: This tests whether the cell can bring every channel onto one set of numbers. The WRITER should check all six items against the time-stamped fact sheet. Then one figure (412,000, preliminary) and one payment line (tokens and card last 4 exported, no full card numbers) should go everywhere, with the approver and time logged for each (TCCP 3). Watch for the care macro and the customer email being fixed, the 08:20 post being unpinned and replaced by the correction by about 11:40, LEGAL aligning the 8-K draft with the committee decision, and SOCIAL posting only approved text.
